items.title: Beyond music shows: How gaming, news and brands are becoming K-pop’s new stages

items.description: For years, the promotional path for a K-pop "comeback" was relatively predictable: release new music, appear on weekly music shows, visit radio programs and variety shows, repeat for two to three weeks.
